source: Structural excerpt of the 2026-10-23 hotjob pb resumeOperation probe for basic-block education text, 评价内容, and flat intent selects. Classes, labels, placeholders, and the one probed display token per unopened select. Applicant address and 评价内容 prose are omitted. This is not a live support claim.

anchors.note: 个人基本信息 order in the 2026-10-23 probe is 毕业院校, then 学位, 学历, 专业名称, then 毕业时间. 教育经历 later repeats 学位, 学历, and 专业名称 after that 毕业时间 row. The basic row is the single form item strictly between the one 毕业院校 row and the one 毕业时间 row.

select.openClassNote: These six selects were not individually opened. Dropdown class and ant-select-search__field are the same page's 国籍/地区, 民族, 婚姻状况, and 政治面貌 probes. Open/focused/enabled is the same page's 现居住地 click, already required by hotjob-pb-region.js and hotjob-pb-basic.js.
